summary: Build and update schedules, link tasks, set baselines, and report progress in Microsoft Project. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Microsoft Project training helps project coordinators, schedulers, and team leads build and maintain project schedules. It covers structuring work breakdowns, linking task dependencies, reviewing the critical path, assigning resources, and setting a baseline. Learners also update progress and prepare Gantt chart views for schedule review and handover.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who build, update, or report project schedules in Microsoft Project and need a repeatable way to manage task data and progress.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with project tasks and milestones is recommended. Bring a laptop with Microsoft Project installed and activated; no coding is required.
